MISSION LA PEROUSE GATE
SITUATION OPAREA: La Pérouse Strait. Shallow water compresses maneuver space while a Soviet reinforcement group closes.
MISSION Pass the strait and withdraw north.
EXECUTION Coordinate the two-boat patrol through the strait, ambush the reinforcement group, and clear north before the ASW screen closes.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Weapons release is authorized against the reinforcement group. Minimize exposure in shallow water.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum is assigned; its loss does not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
